generation.scope: For any finite point graph with an opposite symmetry and a smooth generator of its one-dimensional symmetric quadratic kernel, simultaneous surjectivity in one binary direction forces bisymmetry, including repeated eigenvalues. The only other alternative has exponential growth. The bisymmetric finite test therefore decides regularity throughout this stratum.

open_mathematics: Analyze the rank-three symmetric kernel, finite graphs with no simple component, higher opposite ranks, positive-dimensional fibers and global components and specializations.
